description: This file is a shell script (`ext-tools.sh`) used for managing prebuilt tool extraction and timestamp refreshing in a build environment, specifically for OpenWRT build system. It contains functions for extracting tarballs, refreshing directory timestamps, and handling command-line arguments related to build directories and tools.
external_files: tools tar file passed as argument

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates the timestamps of files in a directory, excluding symlinks.

methods.name: extract_prebuilt_tar
methods.description: Extracts the contents of a tarball passed as argument.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps for the build and staging directories to indicate they are up-to-date.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts the prebuilt tools tarball and refreshes related directories.
